purpose: What Neon production/preview separation REQUIRES for the PaySwap runtime plane, plus the verification status (honest: live execution is credential-gated until the operator vault is re-supplied). scripts/deployment/neon-separation-probe.ts executes every requirement below when the connection bindings are present at run time.

connectionStringEnvNames: DATABASE_URL (topology section 3.1 name; per-environment value supplied at deploy time)
binding.vaultPosture: connection strings and API keys are vault-resolved ONLY — values never enter git, logs, records or reports; records carry host/user/database FACTS only (the pgFacts pattern from runtime-plane-probe.ts)
binding.recordedBindingEvidence: spec/development-state/runtime-plane-probe.json databaseConnectivity.binding (prod pooler host ep-hidden-lab-*, preview pooler host ep-mute-art-*; both databases neondb; both users neondb_owner)

separationRequirements.requirement: BRANCH-LEVEL SEPARATION — production and preview are distinct Neon branches with distinct connection endpoints
separationRequirements.assertion: the production and preview connection strings resolve to DIFFERENT hosts (per-branch pooler endpoints); the Neon API (when bound) lists the main and preview branches in project payswap
separationRequirements.rationale: topology section 2: environments are explicit and checked; preview must never silently share production state

separationRequirements.requirement: ROLE SCOPING — the production credential must not authenticate against the preview branch, and vice versa
separationRequirements.assertion: connecting with the production connection string against the PREVIEW host must be REJECTED (cross-branch credential use fails closed); each branch's role is branch-scoped
separationRequirements.rationale: a shared credential would collapse the separation: any preview leak would be a production credential leak (INV-S02 spirit: scoped authority)

separationRequirements.requirement: STATE SEPARATION — a write on the preview branch must never be visible on the production branch
separationRequirements.assertion: the probe creates a transient marker table on PREVIEW, observes it there, asserts its ABSENCE on PRODUCTION (read-only), then cleans up; production receives NO writes from the probe
separationRequirements.rationale: PostgreSQL is the system of record (topology section 4); preview state is disposable, production state is authoritative

separationRequirements.requirement: PRODUCTION READ-ONLY PROBING — no verification may mutate production
separationRequirements.assertion: production is probed with read-only catalog queries only (current_database/current_user/version/to_regclass)
separationRequirements.rationale: INV-F06/INV-O02 spirit: no tooling mutates authoritative state outside the protocol path

separationRequirements.requirement: CONNECTION-STRING HYGIENE — values are vault-resolved at run time and never recorded
separationRequirements.assertion: the driver prints/records host, user and database names only; any accidental value in output would be a violation of the secret law (AGENTS rule: no secret VALUE ever enters git/logs/reports)
separationRequirements.verification: enforced in driver code (pgFacts extraction before any logging); live execution credential-gated

separationRequirements.requirement: PREVIEW WRITES ARE CLEANED UP — transient probe artifacts are dropped before exit
separationRequirements.assertion: the marker table is dropped from preview at the end of the probe (best-effort with honest error reporting)
separationRequirements.rationale: free-tier hygiene: preview branch storage is budgeted (Neon free plan; see providerContext)

providerContext.documentedFreePlanFacts: provider-documented free plan (public pricing references, cross-checked 2026-10-02): metered compute hours per project, ~0.5 GB storage per project, branch isolation per project; exact current quotas are confirmed in the Neon console — CREDENTIAL-GATED
providerContext.separationModel: Neon branches are copy-on-write isolated PostgreSQL clusters: per-branch endpoint hosts, per-branch roles, per-branch credentials — separation is a first-class provider property this plane relies on
providerContext.upgradePath: a separate Neon PROJECT for preview is the stronger isolation upgrade if preview workloads ever risk the shared project quota; recorded, not required at current scale

verification.gatedBehavior: without the connection strings the driver prints and (with --record) writes an honest credential-gated verification record and exits 0 — no live reading is fabricated (UNKNOWN is not FAILED)
liveChecks: parse both connection strings to host/user/database facts (values never logged)
connect PROD (read-only catalog probe) and PREVIEW; record versions/latencies
marker-table round trip: create on preview -> observe on preview -> assert ABSENT on prod -> drop on preview
cross-branch credential check: PROD connection string against PREVIEW host must be REJECTED (role scoping); a successful cross-login is a separation VIOLATION (exit non-zero)
optional Neon API branch listing when NEON_API_KEY is bound
verification.lastExecution: credential-gated, not executed (operator vault lost to sandbox reset 2026-10-02). The last live per-role database connectivity evidence is spec/development-state/runtime-plane-probe.json (five roles, all ok, PostgreSQL 17.11, distinct prod/preview hosts recorded).
